# LLM-Assisted Search

This page sends a prompt to our Ollama API and receives a streamed response. **TODO**: Retrieve Quarto site embeddings from Weaviate to integrate RAG in this feature.

<div>

<label for="messageInput">Enter your message:</label> <input type="text" id="messageInput" placeholder="Type your message here..." style="width:60%;"> <button onclick="sendMessage()">Send</button>

</div>

```{=html}
<pre id="output">Response will appear here...</pre>
```

```{=html}
<script>
  async function sendMessage() {
    const apiUrl = "http://131.110.210.167:443/api/generate";
    const message = document.getElementById('messageInput').value;
    
    // Construct the payload with a fixed model and the user prompt.
    const payload = {
      model: "llama3.3:70b-instruct-q4_K_M",
      prompt: message
    };

    try {
      const response = await fetch(apiUrl, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      // Use the stream API to process the response.
      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = "";
      let output = "";
      
      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        // Decode the current chunk and append it to our buffer.
        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        
        // Split the buffer into lines; each line should be a JSON object.
        const lines = buffer.split("\n");
        // The last line may be incomplete—save it back to buffer.
        buffer = lines.pop();
        
        for (const line of lines) {
          if (line.trim()) {
            try {
              const jsonObject = JSON.parse(line);
              // If the JSON object has a "response" property, append it.
              if (jsonObject.response) {
                output += jsonObject.response;
                document.getElementById("output").textContent = output;
              }
            } catch (error) {
              console.error("Error parsing line:", error, line);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      // Process any remaining content in the buffer.
      if (buffer.trim()) {
        try {
          const jsonObject = JSON.parse(buffer);
          if (jsonObject.response) {
            output += jsonObject.response;
            document.getElementById("output").textContent = output;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error parsing final buffer:", error, buffer);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      document.getElementById("output").textContent = "Error: " + error.message;
      console.error("Error communicating with the Ollama API:", error);
    }
  }
</script>
```
